shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md
printf '\\n--- test command config ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml
printf '\\n--- repository state ---\\n'
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' ../round-brief.md
sed -n '181,360p' ../round-brief.md
printf '\\n--- available lore commands ---\\n'
command -v lore-query-trace || true
command -v lore_get_ci_failures || true
rg -n \"lore-query-trace|lore_get_ci_failures\" .lore package.json scripts 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD
git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/types/messages.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts

sed -n '1,160p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '1,100p' src/types/messages.test.ts
rg -n \"validated by|list_sessions|session_list\" specs src/transport -g '*.md' -g '*.ts'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git remote -v
git log --oneline --decorate -5
nl -ba src/transport/ws/validation.ts | sed -n '1,150p'
nl -ba src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts | sed -n '70,115p'
nl -ba src/types/messages.test.ts | sed -n '1,110p'
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | sed -n '1,120p'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,230p'
nl -ba src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts | sed -n '35,190p'

rg -n \"from './wsTestSupport|from './.*testSupport|function eventually|const eventually\" src/transport -g '*.test.ts' | head -80

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files scripts | rg 'spec-links/reanchor|reanchor'
rg -n \"export function|function\" scripts/check-spec-links.mjs | head -30
sed -n '1,260p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/types/messages.test.ts
npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/types/messages.test.ts .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs 'src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts::validateMessage › accepts a well-formed list_sessions frame and rejects malformed paging fields'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs 'src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts::the websocket frame validator accepts a well-formed list_sessions frame and rejects malformed paging fields'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '50,175p'
nl -ba src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts | sed -n '84,125p'
nl -ba src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts | sed -n '18,60p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
node scripts/check-spec-links.mjs specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
git diff --check
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat
git diff --check
rg -n \"conversationList\\.acceptance\\.test\\.ts#L\" specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
git diff -- .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git add specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/types/messages.test.ts && git commit -m 'fix websocket list CI findings' && git push origin HEAD"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
